pages.text: $(bold)Pot$(): $(bold)right-click$() with an empty hand to open the GUI, which has 6 ingredient slots, 1 container slot (bowl, plate, etc.) and 1 output slot.$(br2)After adding ingredients it cooks $(bold)automatically$() with $(bold)no heat source$() required; recipes that need a container consume 1 per batch. Take the result from the output slot when done.
